question: What does Weblyft Design do?
answer: Weblyft Design is a web design and development agency based in New Delhi, India. We build custom websites, landing pages, and web applications for local businesses. Every site is custom-designed — no templates — and pricing is transparent.

question: What kind of businesses do you work with?
answer: We specialize in local businesses. Past and current projects include roofing companies, dental studios, landscaping businesses, salons, fitness gyms, restaurants, and tattoo studios.

question: Do you only make full websites, or also single pages and web apps?
answer: All three. We build custom websites, single landing pages, and web applications depending on what your business needs.

question: Do you use templates or WordPress themes?
answer: No templates. Every project is custom-designed from scratch to match your brand, so your site does not look like anyone else's.

question: How much does a website cost?
answer: There are three packages: Starter at $899 (single-page site), Professional at $1,799 (full 5-page business website), and Premium at $2,799 (Professional plus a built-in blog system). All pricing is transparent.

question: What is included in the Starter package ($899)?
answer: A single-page website — ideal for new businesses or freelancers that need an online presence fast. It includes a hero section with call-to-action, about section, services showcase, project gallery, contact form with Google Apps Script integration, mobile-responsive design, and free hosting setup.

question: What is included in the Professional package ($1,799)?
answer: A full 5-page business website: homepage, about page, services page, gallery, and contact page. It adds SEO optimization, Google Analytics integration, Schema.org structured data for rich search results, contact form with email notifications, mobile-responsive design, free hosting setup, and delivery in 10-14 business days.

question: What is included in the Premium package ($2,799)?
answer: Everything in Professional, plus a built-in blog system with a blog listing page, individual blog post pages, blog category tagging, SEO-optimized blog posts, newsletter signup integration, and priority support.

question: Which package is right for a brand-new business?
answer: The Starter package is designed for new businesses or freelancers that just need a simple, professional online presence quickly.

question: Which package is right if I want to grow my traffic with content?
answer: The Premium package — its built-in blog lets you publish regular posts, which improves search visibility. Clients using the blog report strong growth in organic traffic.

question: Do you include SEO in the price?
answer: SEO optimization is included in the Professional package and above. The Starter package does not list SEO as an included feature.

question: Is hosting included?
answer: Free hosting setup is included with the Starter and Professional packages. If you need specifics about ongoing hosting costs, ask via the contact form.

question: How long does a website project take?
answer: The Professional package is delivered in 10-14 business days. Timelines for Starter and Premium projects are confirmed during planning — every project gets a clear roadmap with milestones and timelines.

question: How does your process work?
answer: Four steps: 1) Discovery — we discuss your goals, requirements, and vision; 2) Planning — a clear roadmap with milestones, timelines, and transparent pricing; 3) Creation — the site is built with attention to detail and regular updates; 4) Delivery — the project is delivered on time and backed by support.

question: Will I see updates while the site is being built?
answer: Yes. During the creation phase you receive regular updates on progress.

question: Can you redesign an existing website?
answer: Yes. We build custom websites for local businesses, including redesigns that replace old or self-built sites — clients have come to us after trying to build their own sites.

question: Can the site work on mobile phones?
answer: Yes. Every package includes mobile-responsive design, so the site works well on phones, tablets, and desktops.

question: Can my site take bookings, membership inquiries, or contact form submissions?
answer: Yes. Sites include contact forms (with email notifications), and we have built sites that handle online reservations, membership inquiries, and online booking forms for clients.

question: How much experience does Weblyft Design have?
answer: Over 3 years of hands-on experience with more than 32 projects completed and delivered, with 100% client satisfaction.

question: Are you a top-rated freelancer?
answer: Yes — Weblyft Design is described on the site as a top-rated freelancer with over 32 projects delivered.

question: Do you have client testimonials?
answer: Yes. Clients include a construction company owner whose phone "has been ringing nonstop since launch," a restaurant whose online reservations went up 40% after a redesign, a dentist whose online booking form brought in new patients, a gym owner, and a marketing director who tripled organic traffic with the blog feature.

question: Where are you located and do you work with international clients?
answer: We are based in New Delhi, India, and we work with clients around the world — testimonials come from businesses internationally.

question: How do I get in touch?
answer: Call +91 9816499417 (call anytime) or email weblyft.admin@gmail.com. You can also use the "Get In Touch" or "Start a Project" form on the website.

question: How fast will I get a response?
answer: When you start a project, you get a reply within 24 hours with a plan and a quote — no obligation and no pressure.

question: What do you need from me to get started?
answer: Just share your idea through the contact form or a call. We discuss your goals, requirements, and vision during discovery, then provide a tailored plan and quote.

question: What happens after my site launches?
answer: Delivery includes support after launch. Premium clients also get priority support.
